answer: Cosignatures are collected in plume, verified in violet, and knoll names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 14 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. That bill is paid per identity, so 170 aliases cost 36 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
